title: Concept: Branch record carries an internal address block
description: A branch object that pairs the branch code with a free-text address in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The branch address and code are printed on statements, so a response that returns them for any account id discloses where a customer banks to anyone who can guess an id.
applicability: Deployments that render a branch object that pairs the branch code with a free-text address into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The branch address and code are printed on statements, so a response that returns them for any account id discloses where a customer banks to anyone who can guess an id.
